translation: Took place in posad Serock, 18 July 1890, 8 PM. Appeared personally Calko[?] Rubinsztejn, blacksmith, 49, and Szlama Gonski[?], carter, 60, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 11 AM in posad Serock died a child named Szyja Hersz Melnik, son of Mordka and his wife Ruchla Laja nee Nowodworska, aged one year. Upon eyewitness certification of the death of this child, this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us. The witnesses declared themselves illiterate.
